newsitem.title: USA: US sells 5,500 tons manganese ore for $66.9091/ton.
newsitem.headline: US sells 5,500 tons manganese ore for $66.9091/ton.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Agency said Friday it sold 5,500 short tons of battery grade manganese ore to Eveready Battery Co for $368,000 or $66.9091 a ton.
Next bid opening for manganese ore was set for Dec 3 at 1500 EST/2000 GMT at the agency's offices in suburban Fort Belvoir, Va.

The agency also changed the dates for offering vanadium pentoxide in November and December to Dec 5 and Jan 9 at 1000 EST. Otherwise, bid opening dates would have fallen on U.S. Thanksgiving and Christmas.
